title: Multi-module Maven and private-repository correction guidance
outOfScope: Maven wrapper, Maven settings.xml, credentials, adopter build files, private-repository configuration, hosted CI, release, and any toolchain installation.

sources.reason: Authoritative requirement for Maven reactor, private-repository, and multi-JDK correction guidance.
Existing Java/Maven command preset and non-project-specific boundary.
Regression surface for public Java guidance and its evidence boundary.

rawUserRequest: Execute the complete remediation plan automatically; record authorization in every Work Item Contract. Add correction guidance for multi-module Maven, private repositories, and multiple JDKs without temporary workarounds.

declaredIntent.summary: Provide safe, actionable Maven correction guidance that records unresolved environment facts as blocked instead of guessing private repository access configuration, endpoints, or Java runtimes.

riskAssessment.reason: Incorrect Maven guidance can make an adopter run modules in the wrong order or encourage unsafe handling of private repository access; the template must fail closed on missing environment facts.
riskAssessment.unknownsReviewReason: Adopter-specific reactor command, module graph, settings location, mirror endpoint, project access material, and Java major are intentional collection fields in the template rather than unresolved implementation facts.

scenarioCoverage.scenario: An adopter declares a single reactor command or an explicit dependency order for a multi-module Maven build.
scenarioCoverage.expected: Guidance requires the adopter to choose and record one project-specific route, never inventing module names or a command.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Add focused documentation assertions for reactor and ordered-module alternatives.

scenarioCoverage.scenario: settings.xml, mirror reachability, or private-repository credentials are missing.
scenarioCoverage.expected: Guidance returns a blocked diagnostic and recovery condition without exposing a credential or private endpoint.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Add focused assertions for the explicit blocked/recovery boundary and absence of secret instructions.

scenarioCoverage.scenario: A requested Java lane does not match the actual runtime used for Maven.
scenarioCoverage.expected: Guidance requires recording Java major/runtime for every lane and blocks a mismatch.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Add focused assertions covering Java-major verification before Maven execution.

reasons: Documentation and regression coverage are sufficient for this non-runtime correction template.

executionDecision.reason: The user authorized the remediation plan and this Work Item is limited to repository documentation and regression coverage.

preReviewWarnings: Ensure the guide records dependency order or reactor command without prescribing a guessed project command.
Ensure credentials and private repository endpoint values remain external configuration facts and never enter repository documentation examples.

checkpointPolicy.reason: Record at least one checkpoint before finishing to reduce mid-task drift.

acceptance: The Java correction template gives an adopter a choice between one Maven reactor command and declared dependency-order commands without guessing module names.
The template requires a settings.xml/mirror preflight and reports missing settings, mirror reachability, or credentials as blocked diagnostics with recovery conditions rather than embedding secrets.
The template requires each selected JDK lane to record and verify its actual Java major/runtime before Maven execution.
English, Japanese, and Simplified Chinese guidance retain the same safety and non-authority semantics, with focused regressions.
guidelines: Public operator guidance must distinguish declared facts from inferred facts and must not contain secrets or private repository URLs.
Translations must preserve the command, credential, and Java-runtime safety boundary.

intent.problem: Adopters with multi-module Maven projects can fail when individual modules are run before internal dependencies are built, when a required private mirror or authenticated access is unavailable, or when a named Java lane does not match the actual runtime. Existing Java entry guidance does not provide a bounded correction template for those cases.
constraints: Do not change any adopter Maven command, settings.xml, private repository access configuration, or JDK installation.
Do not include project access material, private repository URLs, or assumed module names.
Do not claim a Maven, private repository, or JDK lane was verified without adopter-local evidence.
Require the adopter to collect the reactor command, module graph, settings location, mirror endpoint, project access material, and Java major before execution.
intent.rationale: A reusable correction template lets an agent collect and verify project-specific facts while keeping private configuration and execution authority with the adopter.
